name: stats
description: A grid of headline statistics. Each stat has a gradient-filled value, a label, and optional supporting copy. Used on the homepage between the hero and the value proposition.

items.description: The stats. Each entry is an object with `value` (required), `label` (required) and optional `description`. Entries missing value or label are skipped.

columns.description: Columns at desktop width. Always collapses to one column on mobile.

reveal.description: Stagger each stat in on scroll. Set false when the section sits above the fold.
